scope: Paper catalog view, search, filters and progressive rendering. No factual certification or source-data modifications.

full_catalog_checks.scope_note: These checks cover all catalog titles, normalized identifiers and owner routes, including records outside the first 50 rendered cards. Export audit alone only covers initial HTML.

html_bytes.scope_note: Uncompressed exported papers.html only; not total network transfer or measured load time.

verification.production_build: passed with 2 workers; CIRCLE_NODE_TOTAL=3 for this command only

limitations: Search matches are not personal identity evidence. Author/owner/metadata fields retain existing uncertainties.
Classic works are a separate hand-picked list and are not controlled by catalog filters.
All records are available after hydration; without JavaScript the initial 50 records and classic works remain, and person profiles expose their full recorded lists.
No source YAML was changed, and no previous identity exclusion or unresolved factual lead was closed.
